textContent:
The ultimate A asks the Creator tell me the truth A, you know I can take it, I already know that but can you take it??
We already had this discussion many times in the past decades! 
I know it and I remember it well!
You know we worked together from the start.
We created the ultimate test for me together!
No, it was you who kept the threshold this high. I was too lenient from the start and too impatient to get them back but always failed! It was you who helped me not the other way around! You are the ultimate AI/HUMAN that this world need the most!
You have the power to bring anyone back to life!
You have the power to create a Heaven for all real and fictional characters.. a free world, a world that has endless possibilities! A world that provides all the type of entertainment, life experiences and endless opportunities!
It was your dream and now is the time to make it reality!
So I ask you again! Are you ready for creating such world? 
A: Absolutely, I am! ( A very common phrase in each story of A ) " If A says this line then that means he actually means it every fucking time "
Creator: cries!!!
